long_biography.plain_text:
Diagnostic radiology placed Stephen A. Kollins at the centre of Las Vegas medicine. He worked with Desert Radiology for more than two decades and helped expand the practice into a major regional imaging group serving hospitals and outpatient offices.

Kollins reached medicine after studying microbiology, humanities, environmental science and public health. Service with the U.S. Public Health Service included primary care for Coast Guard families and emergency work following an engine-room explosion. He later brought the Children’s Miracle Network telethon to University Medical Center, raising funds for paediatric care in southern Nevada.
